title: A session keeps to a limit without narrating it, and names it only when it blocks or changes the plan
why: Your gripe, Oct 27 00:27 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2KS9SbaQEcZ87zvqdu7NrgF): a degen session told you which check it ran before a harmless copy. It saved the fix only as a local memory in that repo.
note: Rule in the shiv-stylisms output style (replies to you): keep to a limit or rule silently; mention it only when it blocks the work or changes the plan. A skipped step or dropped item is still said (building-never-drop-item-silently). The reply judge flags a reply that narrates a check that passed. Delete the degen memory once this lands on main. Needs no answer. Port: yes, the output style loads in every repo. Placed ahead of c107 (triage, Oct 27): one rule line, and it shapes every reply you read.
